_comment: Curated per-tool manual-effort baselines for the usage recap time-saved estimate. manual_seconds = a CONSERVATIVE estimate of how long the same task takes BY HAND per run; time saved = (manual_seconds - observed runtime) x runs, floored at 0. These are authored estimates (no real timings yet) so none is graded above 'med'; low-confidence entries feed the dry-run diagnostic but never a user-facing claim. Replace with measured timings to raise confidence. Keyed by catalog script_path.
_provenance: seeded 2026-08-12 from popular EnneadTab tools; manual_seconds reviewed + corrected by owner (张老板) via pick-options 2026-08-12 -> all owner-set values graded 'med' (expert estimate, not stopwatch-timed).

EnneadTab.tab\\ACE.panel\\Excel Sheet Cr.basis: Creating a batch of titleblock sheets by hand from an Excel list (dozens of sheets, named + placed one by one).

EnneadTab.tab\\ACE.panel\\Family.pulldow.basis: Locating each family's file path and remapping it to a chosen folder by hand.
Manually scanning nested components across project families and renaming them.

EnneadTab.tab\\Import Export.panel\\enne.basis: Setting up and running a multi-format export (DWG/PDF/image) sheet by sheet by hand.

EnneadTab.tab\\Import Export.panel\\sche.basis: Copying a schedule out of Revit into Excel by hand and reformatting.

EnneadTab.tab\\ACE.panel\\Worksets.pulld.basis: Creating the standard Ennead workset structure one workset at a time.

EnneadTab.tab\\Manage.panel\\Merge Famil.basis: Merging family types into a target family manually, type by type.

EnneadTab.tab\\Manage.panel\\load family.basis: Loading each family into each open project by hand (families x documents).

EnneadTab.tab\\Tools.panel\\general_rena.basis: Batch-style renaming that would otherwise be done element by element by hand.

EnneadTab.tab\\Tools.panel\\batch_cut.pu.basis: Cutting curtain-wall elements one by one by hand.

EnneadTab.tab\\ACE.panel\\wall_type_diag.basis: Drawing a wall-type legend view and building the matching view filters by hand.

EnneadTab.tab\\ACE.panel\\transfer_param.basis: Copying data from one parameter to another across elements by hand.

View.tab\\batch_export_rhino_view.button.basis: Exporting several named Rhino views one at a time by hand.

View.tab\\batch_rename_camera.button\\ba.basis: Renaming cameras one by one by hand.

Layer.tab\\merge_layer.button\\merge_lay.basis: Moving objects between layers and deleting the empty layer by hand.

Material.tab\\merge_materials.button\\me.basis: Reassigning objects to a single material and cleaning up duplicates by hand.

Render.tab\\rename_enscape_files.button\.basis: Renaming a batch of Enscape output files by hand to strip the long suffix.
